summary: A plain tab bar: pair each button with the panel it shows, and it handles the rest.
overview: Pair each Button with the GameObject it should show and it handles the click wiring, panel switching and an active/inactive tint on each tab's own graphic. Nothing else in the toolkit does a plain tab bar — the navigator is a full-screen push and pop, which is a different shape.
useCases: Inventory, equipment and stats as tabs on one screen.
Any peer sections where back does not mean anything.

params.tuning: Which tab is selected on enable. Out of range and nothing is selected, which looks like a broken screen.

gotchas.title: It tints the button's own graphic
gotchas.body: A tab whose Button has no target graphic shows no active state, even though switching works.
